claim: The 2024 Mihintale stele transmits a tradition linking Mahinda to the delimitation of the Mahavihara and to the ordination of local clansmen.
bounded_by: This later transmitted foundation narrative must not be conflated with the independently attested administrative structure of the monastery in much later epigraphy.
notes: Run34 promotion of GF-MIH-04; avoids projecting tenth-century institutional evidence into the third century BCE.
